title: Phrasal verbs 1
note: LEXIS pack: the meanings. The grammar (separable/inseparable, pronoun position) is b1_phrasal_verbs, which plays immediately before. Course doc wants ~60 cumulative across packs 1 and 2. First draft 2026-09-02. · 2026-09-04 B1 loop: sentences 8 → 36, one gappable frame per lemma. Four of the eight shipped frames could never gap: three used a past form (*threw away*, *ran out of*, *looked up*) and one SPLIT the verb (*pick me up*), which is exactly what the pack teaches — but sentenceToFrame matches the lemma string literally, so a split frame produces no gap. Every frame here keeps its particle next to its verb; the split belongs to b1_phrasal_verbs, and the frames page now says so. E10: Use is use_mode rewrite, 12 underlined paraphrases. F7: *get up* belongs to leaf_get_b1 (path 43) and *clean up* to leaf_environment_b1 (39); replaced with **wash up** and **stay in**. · Pool-checked against everything taught before leaf_phrasal_1_b1 — 0 unknown types. · 2026-09-04: six rewrite items — the paraphrase had swallowed the object, so the swap left the phrasal verb with nothing after it. The underline now stops at the verb. · 2026-09-05 B1 loop: sentence texture. 27 of 36 Use sentences were FLAT or THIN under check_sentence_texture.py — level with the news leaf for the worst count at B1. A separable phrasal verb wants a short sentence, so this bank was almost entirely `V + it + time phrase`. All 27 rewritten to make one clause move and carry two or more already-taught words. Every phrasal stays contiguous, per this pack's own frames note: the split form (pick me up) is only seen in b1_phrasal_verbs, the grammar unit, because sentenceToFrame cannot gap across it. 0/36 fail now. `box` was drafted onto the take-out item and is untaught before slot 45.

intro.title: You will use these words in
intro.note: Many of these split around the object: *turn the light **off***, *pick the children **up***. The grammar of that split is **Phrasal verbs 1** (b1_phrasal_verbs), which plays just before this pack. Here the job is the meaning.
intro.note_cz: Gramatiku dělitelnosti řeší b1_phrasal_verbs, tady jde o význam.

sentences.en: Please turn on the light when you come in because I cannot see the keys.
sentences.cz: Až přijdeš, rozsviť prosím světlo, protože nevidím na klíče.
accepts: Please turn on the light when you come in because I cannot see the keys

sentences.en: Please turn off the light before you leave the room.
sentences.cz: Než odejdeš z pokoje, zhasni prosím.
accepts: Please turn off the light before you leave the room

sentences.en: Can you turn up the radio because I cannot hear the news?
sentences.cz: Můžeš zesílit rádio, protože neslyším zprávy?
accepts: Can you turn up the radio because I cannot hear the news?

sentences.en: Please turn down the music after ten because the neighbours work early.
sentences.cz: Po desáté prosím ztlum hudbu, protože sousedi chodí brzo do práce.
accepts: Please turn down the music after ten because the neighbours work early

sentences.en: Do not throw away the tickets because we need them at the station.
sentences.cz: Nevyhazuj ty lístky, protože je budeme potřebovat na nádraží.
accepts: Do not throw away the tickets because we need them at the station

sentences.en: I need to tidy up the kitchen before my parents arrive.
sentences.cz: Musím uklidit kuchyň, než přijedou rodiče.
accepts: I need to tidy up the kitchen before my parents arrive

sentences.en: The children put away their books before dinner although nobody asked them.
sentences.cz: Děti si uklidily knihy před večeří, i když je o to nikdo nepožádal.
accepts: The children put away their books before dinner although nobody asked them

sentences.en: I wash up while my husband makes the coffee.
sentences.cz: Já myju nádobí a manžel dělá kávu.
accepts: I wash up while my husband makes the coffee

sentences.en: We want to put up a picture above the sofa which my mother painted.
sentences.cz: Chceme nad pohovku pověsit obraz, který namalovala moje máma.
accepts: We want to put up a picture above the sofa which my mother painted

sentences.en: Please take out the old paper on Monday because the bag is full.
sentences.cz: V pondělí prosím vynes starý papír, protože je ta taška plná.
accepts: Please take out the old paper on Monday because the bag is full

sentences.en: They open up the shop at seven although the first customers come at nine.
sentences.cz: Otevírají obchod v sedm, i když první zákazníci přijdou až v devět.
accepts: They open up the shop at seven although the first customers come at nine

sentences.en: I make up the bed when a guest comes, but nobody stays long.
sentences.cz: Když přijede návštěva, ustelu postel, ale nikdo nezůstane dlouho.
accepts: I make up the bed when a guest comes, but nobody stays long

sentences.en: I wake up before seven because the children are already talking.
sentences.cz: Budím se před sedmou, protože děti už si povídají.
accepts: I wake up before seven because the children are already talking

sentences.en: We stay in on Sunday evening and watch a film which nobody has seen.
sentences.cz: V neděli večer zůstáváme doma a díváme se na film, který nikdo neviděl.
accepts: We stay in on Sunday evening and watch a film which nobody has seen

sentences.en: He put on his coat because the weather changed.
sentences.cz: Oblékl si kabát, protože se změnilo počasí.
accepts: He put on his coat because the weather changed

sentences.en: Please take off your shoes at the door because the floor is clean.
sentences.cz: U dveří si prosím zuj boty, protože je podlaha čistá.
accepts: Please take off your shoes at the door because the floor is clean

sentences.en: I warm up the food from yesterday because there is no time to cook.
sentences.cz: Ohřeju si včerejší jídlo, protože není čas vařit.
accepts: I warm up the food from yesterday because there is no time to cook

sentences.en: We go out on Friday, but on Saturday we stay at home with the children.
sentences.cz: V pátek chodíme ven, ale v sobotu zůstáváme doma s dětmi.
accepts: We go out on Friday, but on Saturday we stay at home with the children

sentences.en: They come back from Italy on Sunday, but the school starts on Monday.
sentences.cz: Z Itálie se vrátí v neděli, ale škola začíná v pondělí.
accepts: They come back from Italy on Sunday, but the school starts on Monday

sentences.en: We often run out of milk before the weekend.
sentences.cz: Před víkendem nám často dojde mléko.
accepts: We often run out of milk before the weekend

sentences.en: We set off at six because the traffic is bad after seven.
sentences.cz: Vyrazíme v šest, protože po sedmé je hustý provoz.
accepts: We set off at six because the traffic is bad after seven

sentences.en: I lie down for ten minutes after lunch because the afternoon is long.
sentences.cz: Po obědě si na deset minut lehnu, protože odpoledne je dlouhé.
accepts: I lie down for ten minutes after lunch because the afternoon is long

sentences.en: We eat out once a month, although the restaurant near us is expensive.
sentences.cz: Jednou za měsíc jdeme na jídlo ven, i když je restaurace u nás drahá.
accepts: We eat out once a month, although the restaurant near us is expensive

sentences.en: Can we switch over? The film has started.
sentences.cz: Můžeme přepnout? Ten film už začal.
accepts: Can we switch over? The film has started

sentences.en: Please fill in the form before you send it.
sentences.cz: Než ten formulář pošleš, vyplň ho prosím.
accepts: Please fill in the form before you send it

sentences.en: They cut off the water for two hours this morning, but nobody told us.
sentences.cz: Dnes ráno na dvě hodiny odstavili vodu, ale nikdo nám to neřekl.
accepts: They cut off the water for two hours this morning, but nobody told us

sentences.en: I look for my keys every morning although they are always in my coat.
sentences.cz: Každé ráno hledám klíče, i když jsou vždycky v kabátě.
accepts: I look for my keys every morning although they are always in my coat

sentences.en: I look up every new word in a dictionary, but I forget it by the evening.
sentences.cz: Každé nové slovo si najdu ve slovníku, ale do večera ho zapomenu.
accepts: I look up every new word in a dictionary, but I forget it by the evening

sentences.en: Can you pick up the children at four because my meeting finishes late?
sentences.cz: Můžeš ve čtyři vyzvednout děti, protože mi schůzka končí pozdě?
accepts: Can you pick up the children at four because my meeting finishes late?

sentences.en: The doctor told me to cut down on coffee, but I drink more than before.
sentences.cz: Doktor mi řekl, ať omezím kávu, ale piju jí víc než dřív.
accepts: The doctor told me to cut down on coffee, but I drink more than before

sentences.en: If the machine says no, try again in a minute.
sentences.cz: Když automat nechce, zkus to za minutu znovu.
accepts: If the machine says no, try again in a minute

sentences.en: They give away free coffee on Monday morning although the shop is always empty.
sentences.cz: V pondělí ráno rozdávají kávu zdarma, i když je obchod vždycky prázdný.
accepts: They give away free coffee on Monday morning although the shop is always empty

sentences.en: I will pay back the money at the end of the month because I get paid then.
sentences.cz: Peníze vrátím na konci měsíce, protože tehdy dostanu výplatu.
accepts: I will pay back the money at the end of the month because I get paid then

sentences.en: They put off the meeting because the boss was ill.
sentences.cz: Schůzku odložili, protože byl šéf nemocný.
accepts: They put off the meeting because the boss was ill

sentences.en: My brother will fix up the old bike which my son wants for his birthday.
sentences.cz: Můj bratr spraví to staré kolo, které chce syn k narozeninám.
accepts: My brother will fix up the old bike which my son wants for his birthday

sentences.en: Hold on a minute because I cannot find the number.
sentences.cz: Vydrž chvilku, protože nemůžu najít to číslo.
accepts: Hold on a minute because I cannot find the number

use_hint: Rewrite the sentence. Replace the underlined words.
